parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the application group.

parameters.name: NewName
parameters.description: The new name of the application group.

parameters.name: OperationName
parameters.description: The name of the configuration update operation.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The JSON string that consists of a set of parameters. Default value: {}.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Set the value to cn-hangzhou.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos update-application-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MyApplicationGroup --new-name UpdateMyApplicationGroup --application-name MyApplication --operation-name NetworkConfig --parameters Status=Running --deployed-revision-id rev-64488a5be25c4a5dbc45 --monitor-metadata example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos UpdateApplicationGroup --region cn-hangzhou --ApplicationName MyApplication --Parameters '{"Status":"Running"}' --MonitorMetadata 'example-string' --OperationName NetworkConfig --NewName UpdateMyApplicationGroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name MyApplicationGroup --DeployedRevisionId 'rev-64488a5be25c4a5dbc45'
